fullPassage: While it is true that individual skills are the most important in the world of sports, having a partner who can cooperate with the player with those skills is equally important. In a marathon, a key reason a front runner can reach the finish line after that long journey is the presence of a pacemaker. The pacemaker helps maintain a steady pace for the front runner, shielding the front runner from the headwind. Without the pacemaker, the front runner has to cope with the harsh wind alone and put in extra effort to maintain the pace. In Formula One, the world's largest car race series, each team enters two cars. Both drivers try their best for victory, but for the team's win, one person employs strategies such as blocking or obstructing other vehicles so that their teammate can get ahead. In rock climbing, individual skills are essential, but when a mistake is made, the person referred to as the belay partner manages the rope to prevent a fall. Similarly, in the case of scuba diving, all divers are paired up with a dive companion called a "buddy." The buddies are responsible for each other's safety. No matter how exceptional your skills may be, you cannot do it alone.

❌ ④ disrupt(방해하다): maintain의 반의어.
det.tip: cooperate(협력) ↔ compete(경쟁), presence(존재) ↔ absence(부재), maintain(유지) ↔ disrupt(방해).

In a marathon, a key reason a front runner can reach the finish line after that long journey is the presence of a pacemaker. The pacemaker helps maintain a steady pace for the front runner, shielding the front runner from the headwind. Without the pacemaker, the front runner has to cope with the harsh wind alone and put in extra effort to maintain the pace. In Formula One, the world's largest car race series, each team enters two cars. Both drivers try their best for victory, but for the team's win, one person employs strategies such as blocking or obstructing other vehicles so that their teammate can get ahead. In rock climbing, individual skills are essential, but when a mistake is made, the person referred to as the belay partner manages the rope to prevent a fall. Similarly, in the case of scuba diving, all divers are paired up with a dive companion called a "buddy." The buddies are responsible for each other's safety. No matter how exceptional your skills may be, ____.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: you can always succeed on your own
individual talent is all that matters
competition is more important than cooperation

det.korean: 아무리 뛰어나도 혼자서는 할 수 없다(you cannot do it alone).
det.analysis:
✅ ② you cannot do it alone: 글 전체가 파트너의 중요성을 강조.
❌ ① 혼자 성공: 글의 논점과 정반대.
❌ ③ 개인 재능만: 파트너의 중요성을 부정.
❌ ④ 경쟁이 협력보다: 협력 강조 글과 반대.
det.tip: 글의 결론 = 주제 요약. 마지막 문장은 핵심 메시지를 담음.

det.analysis:
✅ ① presence(존재): 페이스메이커가 있기에 결승선에 도달 가능.
❌ ② absence(부재): presence의 반의어. 부재가 이유라면 긍정적 맥락과 모순.
❌ ③ failure(실패): 페이스메이커의 성공적 역할과 반대.
❌ ④ weakness(약점): 맥락 불일치.
det.tip: presence(존재) ↔ absence(부재). 'the presence of' = ~의 존재.
